headlines.summary: Authorities arrested 14 people, including four whom they said were sneaking cash out of Attorney General Roger Mariaca’s home and into an ambulance.

headlines.summary: Authorities were trying to determine how an Omani co-pilot nearly crashed a Tel Aviv-bound jet. An Israel official said the co-pilot had “the motive to kill Jews."

headlines.summary: US deploys Roosevelt strike group and 2,000 Marines to the Middle East as part of a wider buildup around Iran.

headlines.summary: Massive US military deployment to the Middle East includes 50,000 troops, F-35s and Marines to pressure Tehran.

headlines.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
headlines.summary: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

headlines.title: 'It's a nightmare.' Former refugee, professor on Trump's new Medicaid policy
headlines.summary: Starting Oct. 1, many immigrants who are here legally lose their Medicaid coverage because of the Republican budget bill passed last year.

headlines.title: A new California law bans child marriage. What's the global outlook on the practice?
headlines.summary: The governor of California has signed into law a ban on child marriage. What is the status of other efforts to ban the practice? And do bans prove effective?

headlines.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
headlines.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

headlines.title: A judge permanently dismisses former Olympian's Reflecting Pool charges
headlines.summary: Citing "exceptional circumstances," a D.C. judge has ruled that the federal government cannot refile its Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn, despite pressure from President Trump to do so.

headlines.title: Washington blames UK base incident on a 'foreign actor'
headlines.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the "hands of a foreign actor" were involved in an incident in which five men were arrested on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses near a British air base used by US forces.

headlines.title: Chancay Port rides a new trade current
headlines.summary: For Santos Javier Gonzales, the deep-water mega port taking shape in his hometown of Chancay, Peru, has become part of his own story — enabling him to build a career without leaving his family behind.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Beijing urges Japan to honor joint political commitments
headlines.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun urged the Japanese authorities to seriously reflect on and correct their wrongdoings and take real actions to return to the purpose and mission of the four key political documents shared by China and Japan.
